title: Exemptions; relation to other laws.
bodyHtml:
[§480J-32]  Exemptions; relation to other laws.  (a)  This chapter shall not apply to the following:

     (1)  A financial institution;

     (2)  A nondepository financial services loan company;

     (3)  An "open end credit plan", as defined in the Truth in Lending Act, title 15 United States Code section 1602(j); or

     (4)  A tax refund anticipation loan.

     (b)  Persons licensed under this chapter shall not be subject to chapter 443B. [L 2021, c 56, pt of §2]
